text: You want size? Lift heavy, bro!
No way. I'll use light weights. I just want to tone.
Here's the thing. There's no such thing as toning. Muscle grows, or it doesn't.
A review compared light and heavy weights, both taken close to failure.
Muscle growth was similar. Heavy weights built more strength.
Light weights build muscle too, if you push them hard. Go heavy for strength. Save this.
